Pahadiyon ki tanseeb, zameen ki sakhti aur narmi dawat-e-fikr hai. Jo mushrik aur kuffar Qayamat ke aane ke munkir thay aur bator-e-inkaar ke aapas mein sawalat kiya karte thay aur marne ke baad jee uthne par ta'ajjub karte thay, un ke jawab mein aur Qayamat ke qaim hone ki khabar mein aur us ke dalail mein Parwardigar-e-Aalam farmata hai ke yeh log aapas mein kis cheez ke bare mein sawalat kar rahe hain? Phir khud farmata hai ke yeh Qayamat ke qaim hone ki babat sawalat karte hain jo bada bhari din hai aur nihayat dil hila dene wala amr hai. Hazrat Qatada (R.H) aur Ibn Zaid (R.H) ne is Naba-e-Azeem (bohat badi khabar) se marne ke baad dobara jee uthna murad liya hai. Magar Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) se yeh marwi hai ke is se murad Quran hai, lekin bazahir theek baat yahi hai ke is se murad marne ke baad jeena hai jaise ke Hazrat Qatada (R.H) aur Hazrat Ibn Zaid (R.H) ka qaul hai. Phir is aayat (الَّذِيْ هُمْ فِيْهِ مُخْـتَلِفُوْنَ) (78. An-Naba: 3) jis mein yeh log aapas mein ikhtilaf rakhte hain, mein jis ikhtilaf ka zikr hai woh yeh hai ke log is ke bare mein mukhtalif mahazon par hain. Un ka ikhtilaf yeh tha ke momin to maante thay ke Qayamat hogi lekin kuffar is ke munkir thay. Phir in munkiron ko Allah Ta'ala dhamkata hai ke tumhein anqareeb is ka ilm hasil ho jayega aur tum abhi abhi maloom kar loge, is mein sakht daant-dapat hai. Phir Allah Ta'ala apni qudrat ki ajeeb-o-ghareeb nishaniyan bayan farma raha hai jin se Qayamat ke qaim karne par us ki qudrat ka hona saaf taur par zahir ho raha hai ke jab woh is tamam maujoodaat ko awwal martaba paida karne par qadir hai to fana ke baad dobara un ka paida karna us par kya mushkil hoga? To farmata hai dekho kya hum ne zameen ko logon ke liye farsh nahin banaya ke woh bichhi hui hai, thehri hui hai harkat nahin karti, tumhari farman-bardar hai aur mazbooti ke sath jami hui hai aur pahadiyon ki meikhein bana kar zameen mein hum ne gaad diya hai, taake na woh hil sake, na apne upar ki cheezon ko hila sake. Zameen aur pahadiyon ki paidaish par ek nazar daal kar phir tum apne aap ko dekho ke hum ne tumhein joda joda paida kiya yani mard-o-aurat ko, aapas mein ek dusre se nafa uthate ho aur tawallud-o-tanasul hota hai, baal-bachay paida ho rahe hain jaise aur jagah farmaya hai aayat (وَمِنْ اٰيٰتِهٖٓ اَنْ خَلَقَ لَكُمْ مِّنْ اَنْفُسِكُمْ اَزْوَاجًا لِّتَسْكُنُوْٓا اِلَيْهَا وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَكُمْ مَّوَدَّةً وَّرَحْمَةً ۭ اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّــقَوْمٍ يَّتَفَكَّرُوْنَ) (30. Ar-Rum: 21).

(Ar-Rum: 21) Allah ki nishaniyon mein se ek yeh hai ke usne khud tum hi mein se tumhare jode paida kiye taake tum un se sukoon hasil karo, usne apni meherbani se tum mein aapas mein mohabbat aur raham daal diya, phir farmata hai hum ne tumhari neend ko harkat ke khatam hone ka sabab banaya taake aaram aur itminan hasil karlo, aur din bhar ki thakaan, kasal aur maandagi door hojaye, isi ma'ani ki aur aayat Surah Furqan mein bhi guzar chuki hai, raat ko hum ne libas banaya ke us ka andhera aur siyahi sab logon par chha jaati hai, jaise aur jagah irshad farmaya aayat (Wallaile iza yaghsha) (92. Al-Lail: 1) qasam hai raat ki jabke woh dhak le, Arab shayar bhi apne she'ron mein raat ko libas kehte hain, Hazrat Qatada R.H ne farmaya hai ke raat sukoon ka ba'is ban jaati hai aur bar-khilaf raat ke din ko hum ne roshan, ujalay wala aur baghair andheray ke banaya hai, taake tum apna kaam dhanda is mein karsako, ja aa sako, byopar, tijarat, len-den karsako aur apni roziyan hasil karsako, hum ne jahan tumhein rehne sehne ko zameen banadi wahan hum ne tumhare oopar saat aasman banaye jo bade lambe chauday, mazboot, pukhta, umda aur zeenat wale hain, tum dekhte ho ke is mein heeron ki tarah chamakte hue sitaray lag rahe hain, ba'az chalte phirte rehte hain aur ba'az ek jagah qaim hain, phir farmaya hum ne suraj ko chamakta chiragh banaya jo tamam jahan ko roshan kardeta hai, har cheez ko jagmaga deta hai aur duniya ko munawwar kardeta hai aur dekho ke hum ne pani ki bhari badliyon se bakasrat pani barsaya, Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain ke hawain chalti hain, idhar se udhar badalon ko le jaati hain aur phir un badalon se khoob barish barasti hai aur zameen ko sairab karti hai, aur bhi bohat se mufassireen ne yahi farmaya hai, mu'siraat se murad ba'az ne to hawa li hai aur ba'az ne badal jo ek ek qatra pani barsate rehte hain, mar'atun mu'siratun Arab mein us aurat ko kehte hain jis ke haiz ka zamana bilkul qareeb aagaya ho, lekin ab tak haiz jaari na hua ho, Hazrat Hasan aur Qatada R.H ne farmaya mu'siraat se murad aasman hai, lekin yeh qaul ghareeb hai, sab se zyada zahir qaul yeh hai ke murad is se badal hain jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Allahu-llazi yursilur-riyaha fatuseeru sahaban) (30. Ar-Rum: 48) Allah Ta'ala hawaon ko bhejta hai jo badalon ko ubharti hain aur unhein parwardigar ki mansha ke mutabiq aasman mein phaila deti hain aur unhein woh tukde tukde kardeta hai phir to dekhta hai ke un ke darmiyan se pani nikalta hai.

Thajjajan ke ma'ani khoob lagatar behne ke hain jo bakasrat beh raha ho aur khoob baras raha ho, ek hadith mein hai afzal hajj woh hai jis mein labbaik khoob pukari jaye aur khoon bakasrat bahaya jaye yani qurbaniyan zyada ki jayen is hadith mein bhi lafz thajj hai, ek aur hadith mein hai ke istihaza ka masla poochne wali ek sahabiya aurat se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke tum rui ka phaya rakh lo, usne kaha ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) woh toh bahut zyada hai main toh har waqt khoon bakasrat bahati rehti hoon, is riwayat mein bhi lafz athujju thajjan hai yani berok barabar khoon aata rehta hai, toh yahan is ayat mein bhi murad yahi hai ke abr se pani kasrat se musalsal barasta hi rehta hai, Wallahu A'lam, phir hum is pani se jo pak, saf, babarakat, nafa bakhsh hai, anaj aur dane paida karte hain jo insan haiwan sab ke khane mein aate hain aur sabziyan ugate hain jo taro taza khai jati hain aur anaj khaliyan mein rakha jata hai phir khaya jata hai aur baghat is pani se phalte phoolte hain aur qisam qisam ke zaiqon, rangon khushbuon wale meway aur phal phool un se paida hote hain go ke zameen ke ek hi tukde par woh mile jule hain. Alfaqan ke ma'ani jama ke hain aur jagah hai ayat (Wa fil ardi qita'um mutajawiratuw wa jannatum min a'nabiw wa zar'uw wa nakhilun sinwanuw wa gairu sinwany yusqa bima'iw wahid, wa nufaddilu ba'daha 'ala ba'din fil ukul, inna fi zalika la'ayatil liqawmiy ya'qilun) (13. Hazrat Qatadah (R.H) farmate hain ke ahqab kabhi khatam nahin hote, ek huqb khatam hua dusra shuru ho gaya. In ahqab ki sahih muddat ka andaza sirf Allah Ta'ala hi ko hai. Haan yeh hum ne suna hai ke ek huqb assi saal ka, ek saal teen sau saath din ka, har din duniya ke ek hazaar saal ka. In dozakhiyon ko na toh kaleje ki thandak hogi na koi achha pani ka milega, haan thande ke badle garm kholta hua pani milega aur khane peene ki cheez behti hui peep milegi. Hameem us sakht garm ko kehte hain jis ke baad hararat ka koi darja na ho, aur ghassaq kehte hain jahannami logon ke lahu, peep, paseena, aansu aur zakhmon se behte hue khoon, peep waghera ko. Is garm cheez ke muqable mein yeh is qadar sard hogi jo bajaye khud azab hai aur behad badbu-dar hai. Surah Sad mein ghassaq ki poori tafsir bayan ho chuki, yeh ab yahan dobara is ke bayan ki chandan zaroorat nahin. Allah Ta'ala apne fazl-o-karam se hamain apne har azab se bachaye. Baaz ne kaha hai bard se murad neend hai, Arab shairon ke shairon mein bhi bard neend ke ma'ani mein paya jata hai. Phir farmaya yeh un ke a'amal ka poora poora badla hai. Un ki bad-a'amaliyan bhi toh dekho ke un ka aqeeda tha ke hisab ka koi din aane hi ka nahin, hum ne jo jo daleelein apne Nabi par nazil farmayi thin yeh un sab ko jhutlate the. Kazzaban masdar hai is wazan par aur masdar bhi aate hain. Phir farmaya ke hum ne apne bandon ke tamam a'amal-o-af'aal ko gin rakha hai aur shumar kar rakha hai, woh sab hamare paas likhe hue hain aur sab ka badla bhi hamare paas tayyar hai. In ahl-e-jahannam se kaha jayega ke ab in azabon ka maza chakho, aise hi aur is se bhi badtareen azab tumhain bakasrat hote rahenge. Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) farmate hain dozakhiyon ke liye is se zyada sakht aur mayus kun aur koi aayat nahin. Un ke azab har waqt barhte hi rahenge. Hazrat Abu Burdah Aslami se sawal hua ke dozakhiyon ke liye is se zyada sakht aur mayus kun aur koi aayat nahin? Farmaya Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is aayat ko parh kar farmaya in logon ko Allah ki nafarmaniyon ne tabah kar diya, lekin is hadith ke rawi Jasr bin Farqad bilkul za'eef hain.

Fuzool aur gunahon se paak duniya. Nek logon ke liye Allah Ta'ala ke haan jo ne'matein-o-rehmatein hain un ka bayan ho raha hai ke yeh kamyab, maqsood-war aur naseeb-dar hain ke jahannam se nijat payi aur jannat mein pahunch gaye. Hada'iq kehte hain khajoor waghera ke baghaat ko, unhein naujawan kunwari hoorein bhi milengi jo ubhre hue seene waliyan aur hum-umar hongi, jaise ke Surah Waqi'ah ki tafsir mein is ka poora bayan guzar chuka. Is hadith mein hai ke jannatiyon ke libas hi Allah Ta'ala ki raza-mandi ke honge, badal un par aayenge aur un se kahenge ke batao hum tum par kya barsayein? Phir jo woh farmayenge, badal un par barsayenge yahan tak ke naujawan kunwari ladkiyan bhi un par barsengi (Ibn Abi Hatim). Unhein sharab-e-tahoor ke chhalkte hue, paak saaf, bharpoor jaam par jaam milenge jis par nasha na hoga ke behooda-goi aur laghw baatein munh se niklein aur kaan mein padein, jaise aur jagah hai aayat (La laghwun feeha wa la ta'theem) (Surah At-Tur: 23). Is mein na laghw hoga na fuzool-goi aur na gunah ki baatein, koi baat jhoot aur fuzool na hogi, woh Dar-us-Salam hai jis mein koi aib ki aur burayi ki baat hi nahin. Yeh un parsa buzurgon ko jo kuch badle mile hain yeh un ke nek a'maal ka natija hai jo Allah Ta'ala ke fazl-o-karam, ehsan-o-inaam ki bina par mile hain, behad kaafi, bakasrat aur bharpoor hain. Arab kehte hain 'a'tani fa-hasabani' ya'ni inaam diya aur bharpoor diya, isi tarah kehte hain 'hasbiyallahu' ya'ni Allah Ta'ala mujhe har tarah kaafi-o-wafi hai.

Ruh-ul-Amin A.S. Allah Ta'ala apni azmat-o-jalal ki khabar de raha hai ke aasman-o-zameen aur un ke darmiyan ki tamam makhlooq ka palne posne wala hai, woh Rahman hai, jis ke raham ne tamam cheezon ko gher liya hai, jab tak us ki ijazat na ho koi us ke samne lab nahin hila sakta, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Man zallazi yashfa'u indahu illa bi-iznih, ya'lamu ma baina aidihim wa ma khalfahum, wa la yuhituna bishai'im min ilmihi illa bima sha'a, wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samawati wal-ard, wa la ya'uduhu hifzuhuma, wa huwal-aliyyul-azim) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 255) yani kaun hai jo us ki ijazat baghair us ki si suraton wale hain khate peete hain na woh farishte hain na insan, ya murad Hazrat Jibraeel A.S hain, Hazrat Jibraeel ko aur jagah bhi Ruh kaha gaya hai, irshad hai ayat (Nazala bihir-ruhul-amin) (Surah Ash-Shu'ara: 193), ise amanat dar ruh ne tere dil par utara hai taake tu darane wala ban jaye, yahan murad se yaqeenan Hazrat Jibraeel hain Hazrat Muqatil farmate hain ke tamam farishton se buzurg, Allah ke muqarrab aur wahi le kar aane wale bhi hain, ya murad Ruh se Quran hai, us ki daleel mein yeh ayat pesh ki ja sakti hai ayat (Wa kazalika auhaina ilaika ruhan min amrina) (Surah Ash-Shura: 52) yani hum ne apne hukm se teri taraf Ruh utari yahan Ruh se murad Quran hai, chatha qaul yeh hai ke yeh ek farishta hai jo tamam makhlooq ke barabar hai, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas farmate hain ke yeh farishta tamam farishton se bahut bada hai, Hazrat Ibn-e-Mas'ud R.A farmate hain ke yeh Ruh nami farishta chauthe aasman mein hai, tamam aasmanon kul pahadon aur sab farishton se bada hai, har din barah hazar tasbeehat padhta hai har ek tasbeeh se ek ek farishta paida hota hai, Qayamat ke din woh akela ek saff ban kar aayega. Lekin yeh qaul bahut hi ghareeb hai, Tabrani mein hadith hai Rasool Allah ﷺ ke farishton mein ek farishta woh bhi hai ke agar use hukm ho ke tamam aasmanon aur zameenon ko luqma bana le to woh ek luqma mein sab ko le le us ki tasbeeh yeh hai Subhanaka haisu kunta Allah tu jahan kahin bhi hai pak hai yeh hadith bhi bahut ghareeb hai balkeh us ke farman-e-Rasool ﷺ hone mein bhi kalam hai, mumkin hai ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas ka qaul ho, aur bhi Bani Israel se liya hua, Wallahu A'lam. Imam Ibn-e-Jareer ne yeh sab aqwal warid kiye hain lekin koi faisla nahin kiya. Mere nazdeek in tamam aqwal mein se behtar qaul yeh hai ke yahan Ruh se murad kul insan hain Wallahu A'lam phir farmaya sirf wahi us din baat kar sake ga jise woh Rahman ijazat de jaise farmaya ayat (Yauma ya'ti la takallamu nafsun illa bi-iznih, faminhum shaqiyyun wa sa'eed) (Surah Hud: 105).

(Hud: 105) Ya'ni jis din woh waqt aayega koi nafs baghair uski ijazat ke kalam bhi nahin kar sakega. Sahih hadith mein bhi hai ke us din siwaye rasoolon ke koi baat na kar sakega, phir farmaya ke uski baat bhi theek-thaak ho, sab se zyada haq baat La Ilaha Illallah hai, phir farmaya ke yeh din haq hai yaqeenan aane wala hai, jo chahe apne Rab ke paas apne lautne ki jagah aur woh rasta bana le jis par chal kar woh uske paas seedha ja pahunche, hum ne tumhein bilkul qareeb aayi hui aafat se aagah kar diya hai, aane wali cheez to aayi hui samajhni chahiye, us din naye purane chhote bade achhe bure kul a'maal insaan ke samne honge jaise farmaya aayat (Wa wajadu ma amilu hadira) jo kiya use samne payenge aur jagah hai aayat (Yunabba'ul insanu yawma'izin bima qaddama wa akhkhar) (75. Al-Qiyamah: 13) har insaan ko uske agle pichhle a'maal se mutanabbeh kiya jayega, us din kafir aarzoo karega kaash ke woh mitti hota paida hi na kiya jata wajood mein hi na aata, Allah ke azaab ko aankh se dekh lega apni badkariyan samne hongi jo paak farishton ke mansab hathon ki likhi hui hain, pas ek ma'ni to yeh hue ke duniya mein hi mitti hone ki ya'ni paida na hone ki aarzoo karega, dusre ma'ni yeh hain ke jab janwaron ka faisla hoga aur unke qisas dilwaye jayenge yahan tak ke be-seeng wali bakri ko agar seeng wali bakri ne mara hoga to us se bhi badla dilwaya jayega phir un se kaha jayega ke mitti ho jao chunancha woh mitti ho jayenge, us waqt yeh kafir insaan bhi kahega ke haye kaash main bhi haiwan hota aur ab mitti ban jata, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki lambi hadith mein bhi yeh mazmoon warid hua hai aur Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) aur Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) se bhi yahi marwi hai, Alhamdulillah Surah Naba ki tafseer khatam hui.
